name: read_skill_resource
description: Read a single bundled resource file from an installed skill package (references/examples/scripts). Path is relative to the skill's resource directory as shown by `list_skill_resources` or `load_skill`.

path.description: Relative path inside the skill's bundled resource directory, e.g. 'references/guide.md' or 'examples/demo.md'.

limit.description: Maximum number of characters to return (default: 50000). Longer files are truncated with a hint.
